# Pathways Within
> Integrated mental health therapy and holistic wellness services on Long Island, NY

## About
Pathways Within provides a 360 degree approach to healing, offering both mental health therapy (individual, couples, child, teen, trauma, EMDR) and holistic wellness services (massage, acupuncture, skincare, injectables, IV vitamin therapy). We believe true wellbeing comes from caring for mind, body, and spirit together.

## Therapy Services (Wisdom)
- Individual Therapy
- Couples Therapy
- Child Therapy
- Teen Therapy
- Trauma Therapy
- EMDR Therapy
- Somatic Therapy
- Group Therapy
- Family Therapy
- Psychiatric Services

## Wellness Services
- Massage Therapy
- Acupuncture
- Skincare
- HydraFacial
- Injectables
- IV Vitamin Infusion
- Red Light Therapy
- Breathwork
- Sound Healing
- Reiki and Energy Work

## Conditions We Treat
- Anxiety
- Depression
- Trauma and PTSD
